source.title: Goblinomics 1.3.0 November 8 Retail 12.1.5 release / raw-source cohort follow-up
source.author: xLN

notes: Fresh Nov 8 release review following the already indexed October Goblinomics DE capture and November 15 code-level audit. v1.3.0 adds WoW Forever compatibility and connector-login fixes; there is no public original player SavedVariables/event export, no new Retail material-yield counts, and no per-cast at-itemLink 305-ilvl disenchant receipt. Prior code audit already established that Disenchant.Flush drops zero-output sessions and Salvage.Rows aggregates base item variants; ProspectMate code provides aggregate input/output totals without completed operation counts. Do not count documentation, software feature counts, historical forum estimates, or current Looter tables as new measured cohorts. All completed-cast denominators, per-output hits, quantity histograms, input/output ranks, at-cast bonuses/build/skill/specializations, actual ore/herb refunds and Eversong Diamond unlock remain unknown for newly sourced samples. This record is a source-exhaustion check, not a measured or modeled numeric result; existing Cardinalai/Honeybone/MikiMM/kyzenbka cohorts are deliberately not duplicated.
lookingFor: New source-original November 2026/current Retail 12.1.5 complete-cast material records for Miststalker's Wristbands 272246 actual ilvl 305 DE; rank-specific Umbral Tin Ore 237362, Refulgent Copper Ore 237359 and Brilliant Silver Ore 237365 prospecting including Eversong Diamond 242608; Tranquility Bloom 236761 10-herb milling, zero-inclusive outputs and Resourcefulness.
